The specification requires current ATR but does not state its lookback period.

assumptions.choice: Risk 1% of current broker value per trade over a one-ATR move, with size equal to the integer part of (current broker value times 0.01) divided by current ATR.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires inverse-ATR sizing to keep risk consistent but does not state the risk budget or rounding rule.

assumptions.choice: Place a protective stop order at exactly 2% below a completed long entry price or 2% above a completed short entry price; cancel it before submitting an opposite-signal close.
assumptions.reason: A native stop order gives the literal intrabar-triggered interpretation of the required 2% stop-loss, including normal gap behavior, while the specification does not state an alternative close-only evaluation convention.
